titulo: The three things that make your website professional
hooks: A website is useless if you do this
Your website could be scaring customers off
Three common mistakes on business websites
voz: Having a website thrown together in a rush isn't enough. You need it to open instantly without making anyone wait. To read comfortably on any phone. And to have a clear button so people can message you directly, no runaround.

bloques.frase: open instantly without making anyone wait

captions: A website isn't just about being online. It's about the person who visits understanding fast what you do and being able to reach you right away.
If your website is slow or hard to read on a phone screen, the customer goes to someone else in two seconds.
Custom design means thinking about whoever's visiting your business: speed, clarity and direct contact without the hassle.
The secret to a useful website is in the simple details: it loads in a snap and it puts the way to reach you right there.
